RESUME

SHAILESH H G Email Id: shaileshgangadharappa@gmail.com

Phone number: +91 7829094627

CAREER OBJECTIVE

To work for an organization that would offer me an opportunity where I can explore my academic knowledge, utilize my skills and abilities for professional growth while being resourceful, innovative and flexible.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

3+ years in SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) modules with 1 End- End implementation and 1 Support project.

EXPERIENCE

Worked at Capgemini Technology Services India limited as SAP EWM Analyst from June 2021 to August 2024.

SAP SKILLS

Hands on experience in implementation and support of SAP EWM

Good Understanding of Business Process related to warehouse processes and other Inventory Management.

Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and documenting complex business requirements, designing and configuring SAP EWM functionalities, and leading successful system implementations.

Skilled in integration of SAP EWM with other SAP modules like PP, MM and SD enabling seamless flow of information across the organization.

EWM triggered opportunistic cross docking for outbound driven process.

Key areas of expertise in Goods Receipt, Deconsolidation, Physical Inventory, Wave Processing, Picking/Packing.

Strong understanding of broad business process in the supply chain & manufacturing space, existing knowledge of the solutions that support these processes.

Working knowledge of Spreadsheet, experience in creating complex presentations and advanced spreadsheets.

• Knowledge on IDOCS.

Effective interpersonal skills with ability to communicate with support personnel at various organization levels.

Experience in conducting user training and providing ongoing support to end-users, ensuring smooth transition and adoption of SAP EWM systems.

PROJECT DETAILS 1

Industry

• Role • Duration • Project

: Manufacturing : SAP EWM Analyst : Jan 2023 to Aug 2024 : Implementation/Support

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Attended workshops to gather business requirements and mapping the system as per the business requirement.

Documented the AS-IS and TO-BE for Inbound, Outbound and Internal Processes • Contacting the business users for requirements gathering. • Basic system configuration. Defining and mapping the SAP ERP & EWM warehouses

Configured EWM warehouse structure and creation of bins • Configuration of storage type search sequence. • Configuration of warehouse process types. • Configuration of put-away (Deconsolidation, VAS) and stock removal process through POSC.

Knowledge on Configuration of packing specific. • Conducting Training to the client team members on EWM processes. • Knowledge on warehouse monitor, Knowledge on Replenishment and Physical inventory, Yard Management, internal movement.

PROJECT DETAILS 2

Industry • • Duration • Role • Project

: FMCG : June 2021 to Dec 2022 : SAP EWM Analyst : Support

RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for handling Incidents/Service Requests. • Used Ticketing tool Service now to handle incidents. • Worked on tickets having high priority (SLA 4 hours). • Resolving SAP operational issues related to interfaces, change management, Process change management, including optimization of business processes. • Leading customer workshops.

Queue Monitor SMQ2/SMQ1. • Production support that involves end to end maintenance with time frame accordance to SLA.

Create documentation on new issues resolved, route cause analysis as well as troubleshooting steps attempted prior to closing or escalation incidents. • Extensively used the warehouse monitor and RF for resolving live issues

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

Completed B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, with an Aggregate of 7.89 CGPA from Channabasaveshwara Institute of Technology, Tumakuru.

PROFESSIONAL STRENGTHS

Excellent planning, interpersonal and Communication skills • SAP EWM, SAP S4/HANA • Microsoft-Excel, Microsoft word, power point. • Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Father Name : Gangadharappa • Date of Birth : 30-Aug-1997. • Permanent Address : #19, Navile at post, Chikkanayakanahalli Tq,

Tumakuru Dist, Karnataka, 572226.

Yours sincerely,

[Shailesh H G]
